iAs.reference_method: iAs speciation reflexed when the parent total reaches min(species limit, 50 percent of the parent-total limit); the species never substitutes for the parent-total report.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Vietnam QCVN 8-2 sets vinegar-specific MLs (Pb 500, tHg 50) and governs those cells directly. Cadmium and total arsenic are governed instead by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for LIQUID foods (Cd 100, tAs 100; uy_rbn_general_cd_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg / uy_rbn_general_tas_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg) — a national catch-all that binds every liquid food without a particular limit and is tighter than the Vietnam vinegar values (Cd 1000, tAs 200). Hidden-hazard flag for the ratchet, NOT a missing limit: the FDA has issued balsamic- and wine-vinegar lead warning letters (grape-derived lead concentrated during must reduction, compounded historically by lead-bearing equipment), and measured balsamic lead can approach or exceed 500 ug/kg — so ALARA and the occurrence ratchet drive tightening after publication even though the sovereign ceiling is the correct initial value. Nickel and total chromium are held under a stainless-steel-migration screen because an acidic food in prolonged stainless contact leaches both.
